evidence.summary: 通过个人访问令牌，将 Qoder 国内版与国际版模型及账号状态接入 DSH。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、cordis.patch.yml、src/index.ts、src/variants.ts、src/adapter.ts、src/auth.ts、src/auth-route.ts、src/shim.ts、src/upstream.ts、src/qoder/transport/default-transport.ts、src/probe-service.ts、src/checkin-scheduler.ts；每个变体独立构建凭证、目录和传输，provider经pi-ai调用带随机共享secret的loopback shim，shim再解析真实PAT并转换Qoder流；目录落地受账号与generation约束，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
limitations: 固定源码级核查Host/provider、凭证与目录、代表传输及失败/关闭；未安装、运行目标测试、调用Qoder、读取真实凭据或验证现行费用/条款。来源移植声明按作者材料保留，不独立认证全上游等价。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 面向已有自有Qoder账号、希望在DSH保留原生Agent循环的个人用户，提供双区域模型供应商接入与账号目录管理。
每个变体独立构建凭证、目录和传输，provider经pi-ai调用带随机共享secret的loopback shim，shim再解析真实PAT并转换Qoder流；目录落地受账号与generation约束，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
固定源码级核查Host/provider、凭证与目录、代表传输及失败/关闭；未安装、运行目标测试、调用Qoder、读取真实凭据或验证现行费用/条款。来源移植声明按作者材料保留，不独立认证全上游等价。
固定package dsh-qoder-connect0.2.12，Host/Client/CLI和bundle入口；声明DSH与Node范围，未核实实时npm、制品与提交对应、Qoder接口和个人使用条件。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1、Node ^22.19.0或>=24 | 必需，包声明 | provider与Host运行 | peer不满足时仅显示不可用状态；本轮未验证兼容 |
| DSH llm/pi-ai与Cordis | 必需 | provider、模型及流转换 | 注册失败释放已落地半边，不能只看卡片 |
| 自有Qoder账号和对应区域PAT | 该区域调用必需 | 交换真实凭据并访问模型 | 中国/国际区不混用；无凭据隐藏目录 |
| loopback端口与内存共享secret | 内部链路必需 | adapter到shim认证 | Host/Origin/Bearer不匹配拒绝，不是公开通用代理 |
| attachments服务 | 图片请求特定条件 | 读取/转换图片 | 缺服务的图片请求不能成立，文本不等同全附件支持 |
| Web/Desktop界面或CLI | 配置入口二选一 | 卡片/额度或终端保存PAT | 卡片与侧栏依赖浏览器，TUI走CLI |
| 上游网络、订阅及额度 | 效果必需 | 模型生成、目录和探测 | 可限流/排队/失效；实时条件本轮未知 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次接入 | 已有订阅、网络与构建资源，金额未知 | profile/peer/区域核对，生成并保存PAT | 本轮未安装或验证当前账户条件 |
| 持续使用 | 真实额度、排队、目录/探测与网络资源未知 | 协议升级、账号切换及目录来源维护 | 宿主成本字段0是未知定价占位，非免费 |
| 失败恢复 | 失败/重试可能消耗额度，金额未知 | 分辨凭证/限流/部分流，查实际账户和会话 | 不以abort推断未执行或未扣费 |
| 退出 | 已耗额度和上游请求不撤销 | 关provider/签到，清保存文件与env，按需撤PAT | clear删失败可被吞，须回读状态 |
当前先观察。若另行决定验证，使用隔离profile、自有授权账号和非敏感样本，先核对区域/账号来源，再检查正文、工具、限流与部分流中断及额度流水；切账号前结束在途请求。无法确认输出完整性、身份或退出状态时，退回官方产品或已验证供应商，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 双区模型接入 | provider、独立存储和流转换实际接线 | 当前服务可用及各模型完整兼容 |
| 目录状态 | 身份/generation检查与来源显示 | saved/fallback模型此刻的权限和有效性 |
| 失败处理 | 鉴权前校验、Retry-After恢复、损坏工具拒绝 | 部分body故障后的完整性、全部中断副作用 |
| 账户收益 | 无真实对账或合格任务对照 | 签到当前活动、现金节约、成功率与总耗时 |
可借鉴的是双变体描述符共享工厂、loopback随机secret与真实PAT分离，以及账号/generation约束目录和探测写回；输出后不重放的鉴权自愈也收窄重复内容风险。代价是双向流转换、元数据占位和多层排队/取消更难解释，故必须把目录成功、传输结束、任务成功和用量核对分开，见 [Q03](#research-q03)、[Q05](#research-q05)。
它把双区域的凭证、模型目录和调用转换整合成DSH provider，并用账号/generation约束目录与探测结果落地；这比只填API地址更明确地组织身份和降级来源。该贡献不等于实时接口可用、模型能力增强或订阅收益保证，见 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
当前账号卡片与正在执行请求可能不同步，清文件还可能重新启用env凭证。普通迭代错误已有错误帧，但shim在部分body I/O报错后补DONE的分支仍需完整性验证；正常封包、零成本元数据或本地abort都不能替代真实结果与额度核对，见 [Q03](#research-q03)。
未来可为请求保留不含PAT的区域/账号指纹及配置代数，关联排队、接受、终态和用量未知，在切账号时显式标出旧身份请求。用慢目录、切卡、自愈、取消和部分流故障比较错归属与重复生成；泄露凭证或把abort当未扣费即否定相应保证。该方向未验证，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: novelty25%=9：[Q01](#research-q01) README出处承认骨架与传输移植，index:848-881将双区接入DSH，局部组合增量高于0；不把上游能力算原创，未达50%。mechanism50%=15：[Q02](#research-q02) index:1620-1658/1997-2024的身份与generation防旧结果覆盖，超过25%简单入口；[Q03](#research-q03)请求和部分流边界仍在，未达75%关键限制已解决。transferability25%=5：variants:55-87集中区域差异可借鉴，但adapter/shim绑定pi-ai、DSH及Qoder非官方协议，跨平台需重建，未达50%通用机制。simplification50%=8：[Q02](#research-q02) 两variant共享工厂且loopback让现有pi-ai承担宿主流集成，比逐区复制接入有具体组合简化；转换层和调试成本增加，未达75%。

business.rationale: workflow25%=9：[Q01](#research-q01) 模型入口从Qoder产品移入DSH，账号/目录集中是局部流程便利；未显示任务责任或交接组织实质变化，不取50%。delivery25%=8：[Q02](#research-q02) 把供应商事件转为宿主可消费流有有限交付增量，但最终任务与工具产物仍由原模型/宿主形成，未达50%新价值单元。reach50%=10：[Q01](#research-q01) 两区PAT与provider让已有Qoder个人账号在DSH使用模型，超过25%仅显示名称；接口与身份要求和未验服务限制触达，未达75%。economics0%：[Q04](#research-q04) NO_COST为无法逐token定价的元数据、仍消耗已有订阅额度，未识别可核查的额外资源组织或收费结构改变，不取25%；不以费用未知支持数值收益。

recommendation.reason: 已有自有 Qoder 账号且希望保留 DSH 原生循环的个人用户可以关注这套社区接入。相对手填通用 API 地址，它组织双区域凭证、账号目录与排队错误转换，当前服务和额度收益仍未验证。账号来源不明、接口持续拒绝或输出完整性无法确认时，用户应停止使用该接入并退回 Qoder 官方产品或已有已验证供应商。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README:5-13与index:848-881明确自有Qoder订阅、DSH循环及双区任务边界，超过50%单纯用途；无独立持续采用证据，不取100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) variants、目录generation与loopback流转换比手填地址有解释性增量，超过25%入口包装；接口/完整性及实际收益未知，未达75%实质结果改善。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) provider→shim→PAT→transport→SSE及[Q03](#research-q03)主要失败分支有固定源码，超过25%片段；既有错误帧作为反证也纳入。未跑宿主/上游，无本地测试，最高50%，不取75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 多账号/环境兜底、非官方协议、额度及长排队需用户维护；[Q03](#research-q03)清文件不必然退出、部分流完整性未验，使收益尚难覆盖排障负担。退回官方产品是可行退路，故高于0不可接受且无退路；当前缺少可验证恢复和对账，不取50%。

publication.summaries.text: 通过个人访问令牌，将 Qoder 国内版与国际版模型及账号状态接入 DSH。

items.模型工具: qoder与qoder-global供应商模型及正文/推理/工具调用流适配
items.界面: 双区域PAT卡片、目录来源和账号切换状态
items.后台: 账号目录刷新、探测同意门槛及签到调度清理

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 双区域provider | Qoder模型进入DSH原生循环 | 自有区域PAT、兼容peer及可用上游，非完整CLI嵌入 |
| 多PAT保存与切换 | 选择活动账号并保留区域独立文件 | 校验后保存，clear后env可能重新生效，不撤上游PAT |
| 目录三级降级 | 显示live/saved/fallback来源 | 账号/generation约束落地，缓存不证明实时可用 |
| 流式错误与排队转换 | 保留Retry-After、阻止损坏工具参数 | 普通异常有错误帧，部分body I/O结束另需完整性核验 |
| 推理档位探测 | 在未声明时取得被接受的参数集合 | 需同意且消耗额度；参数接受不证明推理效果 |

publication.advice.text: 当前先观察。若另行决定验证，使用隔离profile、自有授权账号和非敏感样本，先核对区域/账号来源，再检查正文、工具、限流与部分流中断及额度流水；切账号前结束在途请求。无法确认输出完整性、身份或退出状态时，退回官方产品或已验证供应商，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# DSH Qoder Connect\n\n[English](./README.en.md) | **简体中文**\n\n把 **Qoder 订阅**的模型以个人访问令牌（PAT）接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的社区插件。一个插件同时服务两条 Qoder 产品线，各自一张设置卡片、一个 provider、一套凭证与模型目录，互不混用：\n\n| 变体 | provider id | 卡片标题（中文界面） | PAT 生成站点 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 国内版 | `qoder` | Qoder（国内版） | qoder.com.cn |\n| 国际版 | `qoder-global` | Qoder Global（国际版） | qoder.com |\n\n只需要哪一版就只配哪一版：未保存 PAT 的变体不显示模型分组，另一版完全不受影响。流式输出、推理内容、工具调用走插件内置的 Qoder 传输层；对话循环、压缩与权限始终由 DSH 本体掌控。\n\n## 功能\n\n- **多 PAT 保存与手动切换**：每个变体可保存多枚 PAT，卡片上用下拉框切换当前账号（切换只换签名令牌，模型开关、上下文窗口、签到与侧栏额度等配置全部共享，不随账号变化）；可「添加 PAT」「删除当前」「清除全部」。保存时先实时校验，通过才落盘；删除或切换不会误删其他账号的已保存模型目录与探测记录。\n- **PAT 即存即用**：保存时先校验，通过才落盘，模型分组立即出现，无需重启 DSH；粘贴打错不会把可用凭据弄丢。\n- **双变体独立配置**：`qoder`（china）与 `qoder-global`（global）各有自己的凭证文件、路由与已保存目录——qoder.com 生成的令牌对中国区无效，反之亦然，两套永不互串。\n- **模型目录三级降级（live → saved → fallback）**：卡片明示当前列表来自哪里——「模型列表更新于 …」（实时拉取）、「当前显示已保存的模型列表，更新于 …」（本账号上次成功目录，重启或断网后顶上来）、「当前显示内置模型列表（尚未从 Qoder 更新）」（编译进插件的兜底名单）；最近一次拉取失败时附带原因，并可在卡片上手动「刷新」（同时刷新状态与模型列表）。\n- **上下文窗口一键切换**：两张变体卡片的「上下文窗口」页列出每个模型的容量（默认值与上游声明的最大值），并各自提供「使用上游声明的最大上下文窗口」开关（默认勾选）：勾选按最大窗口（如 Qwen3.8-Max 的 1M）发请求，不勾选按默认窗口（200K），两版开关状态独立保存、互不影响。\n- **模型自由开关与批量管理**：两张变体卡片均提供「模型开关」页（位于上下文窗口与额度明细之间），可自由开启或关闭指定模型；关闭的模型将自动从 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器中隐藏，避免误选与列表冗长；顶部提供按名称/ID的即时搜索框，并支持全选与一键「批量开启」/「批量关闭」。\n- **每日自动签到与日志明细**：支持每天自动签到领取 100 Credits 算力额度，**签到时刻可在卡片上自定义**（默认 10:00，即上游刷新时间，按 UTC+8），配备双端开关与开机防漏补签机制；卡片常驻「签到日志」面板，提供执行流水记录与「立即签到」、「刷新」、「清空日志」快捷操作。\n- **侧栏额度展示 + 额度明细**：「Qoder 侧栏展示」卡片可分别为两版开启侧栏底部的额度小卡（默认关，开启前需为该变体保存 PAT），共享一个刷新间隔（默认 5 分钟，最小 1 分钟）。点侧栏小卡在中间面板打开「Qoder 额度」明细：按资源包逐行给出「剩余 / 总量 + 进度条｜到期时间」，活动赠送包（如国际版「SOTA 专属积分」）按上游给定的名称与**各自的到期日**单独成行；账号整体无到期（上游回 9999 占位值）时展示 PAT 的授权时间而非假日期；再点同一张卡关闭，点另一张切换到对应版本。\n- **倍率显示 `x<priceFactor>`**：模型名后直接拼上游报价的价格倍率（如 `某模型 · x0.79`，免费为 `x0`），来自目录接口的 `price_factor` 字段，仅作展示、不影响请求；上游未报倍率的模型不显示后缀，不会凭空补一个数。\n- **尊重上游的排队建议**：Qoder 在排队/限流答复里给出 `retryAfterSeconds` 时（401/403/429 的 body），插件把它转成本机 `Retry-After` 响应头，并作为 `failure.providerRetryAfterMs` 交给 DSH 的重试策略；宿主重试引擎因此会等到上游要求的时刻再发起下一次请求，而不是用本地退避提前撞回同一个未打开的窗口。\n\n## 界面一览\n\n### 侧栏额度小卡与额度明细\n\n在「Qoder 10:00，按 UTC+8）；在卡片底部的「签到日志」面板中查看签到流水、立即签到或清空日志：\n\n![每日自动签到与签到日志](assets/7.png)\n\n## 安装\n\n前置条件：\n\n- DSH 核心 `0.2.1-rc.1` 及以上（本插件 peer 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/*` `>=0.2.1-rc.1` 线）；\n- Node.js `^22.19.0 ||       "content": "/**\n * Probe orchestration: the serial queue, the consent gate, and the bridge from an\n * observation to what the adapter may expose.\n *\n * Separate from {@link module:dsh-qoder-connect/probe} so the protocol stays a\n * pure function of one model's responses. Two structural rules: one probe at a\n * time (a real chat must not contend with a sweep), and nothing at all without\n * explicit consent.\n *\n * @module dsh-qoder-connect/probe-service\n */\n\nimport type { QoderCredentialStore } from './auth.ts'\nimport type { QoderCatalog } from './catalog.ts'\nimport { probeModel, type ProbeSender, type SentinelFactory } from './probe.ts'\nimport { fingerprintModel, type QoderProbeRecord, type QoderProbeStore } from './probe-store.ts'\nimport type { QoderUpstreamClient } from './upstream.ts'\n\n/** What the caller learns about a completed probe. */\nexport type QoderProbeStatus =\n  | { state: 'ok'; validation: QoderProbeRecord['validation']; efforts: readonly string[]; requests: number }\n  | { state: 'unavailable'; reason: string }\n\n/** Options for {@link QoderProbeService}. */\nexport interface QoderProbeServiceOptions {\n  store: QoderProbeStore\n  catalog: QoderCatalog\n  credentials: QoderCredentialStore\n  client: QoderUpstreamClient\n  /** Whether probing is permitted at all; consulted before every sweep. */\n  consent: () => boolean\n  /**\n   * The account currently in effect, as a one-way hash of the credential, or\n   * `undefined` while signed out.\n   *\n   * Re-checked after the sweep finishes: an observation produced under account A\n   * must not be stored once B is in effect, and the caller's `clear()` on a switch\n   * is not enough because an in-flight probe completes after it.\n   */\n  account: () => string | undefined\n  sentinel?: SentinelFactory\n  /** Injectable for tests; defaults to the live upstream sender. */\n  send?: (modelId: string) => ProbeSender\n}\n\n/**\n * Serial probe runner. One instance is shared by the manual API and any\n * future automatic trigger, so the two can never overlap.\n */\nexport class QoderProbeService {\n  private readonly options: QoderProbeServiceOptions\n  private queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve()\n  private readonly pending = new Map<string, Promise<QoderProbeStatus>>()\n  private running = false\n\n  constructor(options: QoderProbeServiceOptions) {\n    this.options = options\n  }\n\n  /** Whether a sweep is in flight right now. */\n  isRunning(): boolean {\n    return this.running\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The record the adapter may use for this model, or `undefined`.\n   *\n   * A declared set always wins, so a model declaring `supportedEfforts` is never\n   * answered from an observation.\n   */\n  recordFor(modelId: string): QoderProbeRecord | undefined {\n    const info = this.options.catalog.current().find(model => model.id === modelId)\n    if (info === undefined) return undefined\n    if (info.reasoning?.supportedEfforts !== undefined && info.reasoning.supportedEfforts.length > 0) {\n      return undefined\n    }\n    const account = this.options.account()\n    // Signed out: there is no account to attribute an observation to, so none\n    // is served (a previous account's record must not answer here).\n    if (account === undefined) return undefined\n    return this.options.store.get(modelId, fingerprintModel(info), account)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Probe one model, serially.\n   *\n   * The authenticated manual route supplies one-request consent after UI\n   * confirmation; other callers must pass the configured consent gate. Explicit\n   * requests bypass historical results but share an ongoing run.\n   */\n  async probe(modelId: string, manualConsent = false): Promise<QoderProbeStatus> {\n    if (!manualConsent && !this.options.consent()) {\n      return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'probing is not authorized' }\n    }\n    const info = this.options.catalog.current().find(model => model.id === modelId)\n    if (info === undefined) return { state: 'unavailable', reason: `unknown model: ${modelId}` }\n    const account = this.options.account()\n    if (account === undefined) return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'no Qoder credential' }\n    const pendingKey = JSON.stringify([account, modelId])\n    const pending = this.pending.get(pendingKey)\n    if (pending !== undefined) return pending\n\n    const run = this.queue.then(async (): Promise<QoderProbeStatus> => {\n      // Re-read inside the queue: an earlier sweep may have changed the catalog\n      // or already answered this model.\n      const current = this.options.catalog.current().find(model => model.id === modelId)\n      if (current === undefined) return { state: 'unavailable', reason: `unknown model: ${modelId}` }\n      if (!manualConsent && !this.options.consent()) {\n        return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'probing is not authorized' }\n      }\n      if (current.reasoning?.supports !== true || (current.reasoning.supportedEfforts?.length ?? 0) > 0) {\n        return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'model does not need detection' }\n      }\n      const cached = this.recordFor(modelId)\n      if (!manualConsent && cached !== undefined && cached.validation !== 'unknown') {\n        return { state: 'ok', validation: cached.validation, efforts: cached.efforts, requests: 0 }\n      }\n\n      // The account this sweep runs for. Captured before the requests and\n      // re-checked before write-back: a probe can outlive its account, and storing\n      // afterwards would resurrect the previous account's answer.\n      const activeAccount = this.options.account()\n      if (activeAccount !== account) return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'account changed before detection' }\n      const credential = await this.options.credentials.current()\n      if (credential === undefined) return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'no Qoder credential' }\n\n      const send = this.options.send === undefined\n        ? (effort: string | undefined, signal: AbortSignal) =>\n            this.options.client.probeEffort(modelId, effort, signal)\n        : this.options.send(modelId)\n\n      this.running = true\n      try {\n        const outcome = await probeModel({\n          send,\n          ...this.options.sentinel === undefined ? {} : { sentinel: this.options.sentinel },\n        })\n        // The account may have changed while the requests were in flight. Drop\n        // the observation rather than attribute it to whoever is signed in now.\n        if (this.options.account() !== account) {\n          return { state: 'unavailable', reason: 'account changed during detection' }\n        }\n        const record = this.options.store.record(\n          fingerprintModel(current),\n          outcome.validation,\n          outcome.efforts,\n          account,\n        )\n        this.options.store.set(modelId, record)\n        if (outcome.validation === 'unknown') {\n          return { state: 'unavailable', reason: outcome.reason }\n        }\n        return { state: 'ok', validation: outcome.validation, efforts: record.efforts, requests: outcome.requests }\n      } finally {\n        this.running = false\n      }\n    })\n\n    // Keep the chain alive regardless of this run's outcome, so one failure does\n    // not poison every later probe.\n    this.queue = run.catch(() => undefined)\n    this.pending.set(pendingKey, run)\n    try {\n      return await run\n    } finally {\n      this.pending.delete(pendingKey)\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/** Scheduling and catch-up orchestration for daily 10:00 (UTC+8) check-in. */\n\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { dirname, join } from 'node:path'\nimport type { QoderCheckInResult } from './qoder/transport/checkin.ts'\nimport { qoderPluginDataDir } from './paths.ts'\nimport { formatUtc8Date, utc8WallClock } from './utc8.ts'\n\nexport interface VariantCheckInTarget {\n  variantId: string\n  /**\n   * Claim today's benefit for this variant.\n   *\n   * The variant's transport owns credential resolution, so this takes no token; a\n   * missing credential surfaces as an `error` result rather than a throw, so one\n   * signed-out variant cannot stop the sweep for the other.\n   */\n  checkIn: (signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<QoderCheckInResult>\n  /**\n   * The moment this variant checks in, as minutes past midnight in UTC+8.\n   *\n   * A getter, not a value: the user can retime it on the card and the scheduler\n   * must see the new value on its next pass without being rebuilt.\n   */\n  minuteOfDay: () => number\n  onClaimed?: () => void\n}\n\nexport interface CheckInLogItem {\n  id: string\n  date: string\n  timestamp: number\n  status: 'claimed' | 'already-claimed' | 'before-window' | 'no-campaign' | 'error'\n  amount?: number | undefined\n  campaignKey?: string | undefined\n  message?: string | undefined\n}\n\nexport interface CheckInRecord {\n  lastDate: string\n  lastAt: number\n  status: 'claimed' | 'already-claimed' | 'before-window' | 'no-campaign' | 'error'\n  amount?: number | undefined\n  message?: string | undefined\n  logs?: CheckInLogItem[] | undefined\n}\n\nexport interface CheckInStatusStore {\n  read(variantId: string): CheckInRecord | undefined\n  write(variantId: string, record: CheckInRecord): void\n  clearLogs(variantId: string): void\n}\n\nexport class JsonFileCheckInStore implements CheckInStatusStore {\n  private readonly filePath: string\n\n  constructor(filePath?: string) {\n    this.filePath = filePath ?? join(qoderPluginDataDir(), 'checkin-status.json')\n  }\n\n  private readAll(): Record<string, CheckInRecord> {\n    try {\n      if (!existsSync(this.filePath)) return {}\n      const raw = readFileSync(this.filePath, 'utf-8')\n      return JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, CheckInRecord>\n    } catch {\n      return {}\n    }\n  }\n\n  read(variantId: string): CheckInRecord | undefined {\n    return this.readAll()[variantId]\n  }\n\n  clearLogs(variantId: string): void {\n    try {\n      const all = this.readAll()\n      if (all[variantId]) {\n        all[variantId] = {\n          ...all[variantId],\n          logs: [],\n        }\n        mkdirSync(dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true })\n        writeFileSync(this.filePath, JSON.stringify(all, null, 2), 'utf-8')\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Best-effort persistence\n    }\n  }\n\n  write(variantId: string, record: CheckInRecord): void {\n    try {\n      const all = this.readAll()\n      const existing = all[variantId]\n      const existingLogs = existing?.logs ?? []\n      const newLog: CheckInLogItem = {\n        id: `${record.lastDate}-${record.lastAt}`,\n        date: record.lastDate,\n        timestamp: record.lastAt,\n        status: record.status,\n        ...record.amount === undefined ? {} : { amount: record.amount },\n        ...record.message === undefined ? {} : { message: record.message },\n      }\n      const updatedLogs = [newLog, ...existingLogs.filter(l => l.id !== newLog.id)].slice(0, 30)\n      all[variantId] = {\n        ...record,\n        logs: updatedLogs,\n      }\n      mkdirSync(dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true })\n      writeFileSync(this.filePath, JSON.stringify(all, null, 2), 'utf-8')\n    } catch {\n      // Best-effort persistence\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The moment a variant checks in, as minutes past midnight in UTC+8.\n *\n * 600 is 10:00, which is when the upstream resets the daily campaign; it is\n * also the default a variant falls back to when its setting is absent or\n * malformed, so a bad stored value can never leave the day unscheduled.\n */\nexport const DEFAULT_CHECK_IN_MINUTE = 600\n\n/**\n * The earliest moment a variant may be scheduled for: the window's opening.\n *\n * An earlier moment would read the *previous* window's status and settle a day\n * that was never claimed. The settings schema refuses such a value; this is the\n * floor a stored one is lifted to, so an old or hand-edited config still lands on\n * something honourable.\n */\nexport const EARLIEST_CHECK_IN_MINUTE = DEFAULT_CHECK_IN_MINUTE\n\n/** Clamp any stored/typed value onto a minute the plugin can actually honour. */\nexport function normalizeCheckInMinute(value: unknown): number {\n  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_CHECK_IN_MINUTE\n  const whole = Math.trunc(value)\n  if (whole < 0 || whole > 1439) return DEFAULT_CHECK_IN_MINUTE\n  return Math.max(EARLIEST_CHECK_IN_MINUTE, whole)\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculates milliseconds until the next occurrence of `minuteOfDay` (UTC+8).\n *\n * Five seconds past the configured minute are used so the request lands after\n * the upstream has flipped the day over rather than on the boundary itself.\n */\nexport function msUntilNextCheckIn(minuteOfDay: number, nowMs: number = Date.now()): number {\n  const minute = normalizeCheckInMinute(minuteOfDay)\n  // Calculate current UTC+8 wall clock\n  const utc8Time = utc8WallClock(nowMs)\n  const targetUtc8 = new Date(utc8Time.getTime())\n  targetUtc8.setHours(Math.floor(minute / 60), minute % 60, 5, 0)\n\n  let diff = targetUtc8.getTime() - utc8Time.getTime()\n  if (diff <= 0) {\n    // Today's moment has passed, schedule for tomorrow\n    targetUtc8.setDate(targetUtc8.getDate() + 1)\n    diff = targetUtc8.getTime() - utc8Time.getTime()\n  }\n  return diff\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether today's configured check-in moment (UTC+8) has already passed.\n */\nexport function isPastCheckInTime(minuteOfDay: number, nowMs: number = Date.now()): boolean {\n  const minute = normalizeCheckInMinute(minuteOfDay)\n  const utc8 = utc8WallClock(nowMs)\n  return utc8.getHours() * 60 + utc8.getMinutes() >= minute\n}\n\nexport interface CheckInSchedulerOptions {\n  targets: VariantCheckInTarget[]\n  isEnabled: (variantId: string) => boolean\n  store?: CheckInStatusStore | undefined\n  onResult?: ((result: QoderCheckInResult) => void) | undefined\n  now?: (() => number) | undefined\n}\n\nexport class CheckInScheduler {\n  private readonly targets: VariantCheckInTarget[]\n  private readonly isEnabled: (variantId: string) => boolean\n  private readonly store: CheckInStatusStore\n  private readonly onResult: ((result: QoderCheckInResult) => void) | undefined\n  private readonly now: () => number\n  /**\n   * One timer per enabled variant, keyed by variant id.\n   *\n   * Per-variant because the two products may check in at different moments.\n   */\n  private readonly timers = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>()\n  /**\n   * Variants with a sweep in progress, so concurrent callers cannot double-claim.\n   */\n  private readonly inFlight = new Set<string>()\n  /** When each variant's timer is next due, epoch ms, for the card to show. */\n  private readonly nextRuns = new Map<string, number>()\n  private disposed = false\n\n  constructor(options: CheckInSchedulerOptions) {\n    this.targets = options.targets\n    this.isEnabled = options.isEnabled\n    this.store = options.store ?? new JsonFileCheckInStore()\n    this.onResult = options.onResult\n    this.now = options.now ?? Date.now\n  }\n\n  start(): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    // Immediate catch-up evaluation on startup\n    void this.sweepAll(true)\n    this.rearm()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Re-run the startup catch-up once the toggles are actually readable.\n   *\n   * `start()` runs before the settings section hands over its stored values, so\n   * the first sweep may skip the day. The sweep is idempotent, so a day already\n   * handled costs nothing.\n   */\n  catchUp(): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    void this.sweepAll(true)\n  }\n\n  dispose(): void {\n    this.disposed = true\n    for (const timer of this.timers.values()) clearTimeout(timer)\n    this.timers.clear()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Re-place every variant's timer.\n   *\n   * Called after each fire and whenever configuration lands, so a retimed card\n   * takes effect without a restart. A timer is placed for every target, including\n   * disabled variants: `start()` runs before the stored toggles are readable, and\n   * gating placement on `isEnabled` left the variant with no timer and nothing to\n   * re-arm it. Whether work is due is decided in the sweep; the timer only decides\n   * when to look.\n   */\n  rearm(): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    for (const timer of this.timers.values()) clearTimeout(timer)\n    this.timers.clear()\n    this.nextRuns.clear()\n    const nowMs = this.now()\n    for (const target of this.targets) {\n      const delay = msUntilNextCheckIn(target.minuteOfDay(), nowMs)\n      // Published so the card can say when the next automatic run is due: a day\n      // already claimed goes quiet by design, and silence looks like a broken\n      // scheduler.\n      this.nextRuns.set(target.variantId, nowMs + delay)\n      const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n        this.timers.delete(target.variantId)\n        void this.sweepAll(false, target.variantId).finally(() => { this.rearm() })\n      }, delay)\n      timer.unref?.()\n      this.timers.set(target.variantId, timer)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** When this variant's timer is next due, epoch ms; absent before first arm. */\n  nextRunAt(variantId: string): number | undefined {\n    return this.nextRuns.get(variantId)\n  }\n\n  async sweepAll(isCatchUp: boolean, only?: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    const nowMs = this.now()\n    const today = formatUtc8Date(nowMs)\n\n    for (const target of this.targets) {\n      if (only !== undefined && target.variantId !== only) continue\n      if (!this.isEnabled(target.variantId)) continue\n      // One variant is never swept twice at once: `start()` and the settings\n      // section's first catch-up can both be in the air during assembly.\n      if (this.inFlight.has(target.variantId)) continue\n      this.inFlight.add(target.variantId)\n      try {\n        await this.sweepOne(target, isCatchUp, nowMs, today)\n      } finally {\n        this.inFlight.delete(target.variantId)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async sweepOne(\n    target: VariantCheckInTarget,\n    isCatchUp: boolean,\n    nowMs: number,\n    today: string,\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    const record = this.store.read(target.variantId)\n    // Only an actually claimed day is settled. \"no campaign\", \"before window\" and\n    // errors must stay retryable, otherwise one early failure burns the whole day.\n    const settledToday = record?.lastDate === today\n      && (record.status === 'claimed' || record.status === 'already-claimed')\n    if (settledToday) {\n      // A scheduled run that finds the day already handled still leaves a row:\n      // total silence is indistinguishable from a timer that never fired.\n      if (!isCatchUp) {\n        this.store.write(target.variantId, {\n          lastDate: today,\n          lastAt: nowMs,\n          status: 'already-claimed',\n          ...record.amount === undefined ? {} : { amount: record.amount },\n          message: 'Scheduled check-in ran; today was already claimed',\n        })\n      }\n      return\n    }\n    // A catch-up run only makes sense once this variant's configured moment\n    // has passed; before it, the variant's own timer still owns today.\n    if (isCatchUp && !isPastCheckInTime(target.minuteOfDay(), nowMs)) return\n\n    let result: QoderCheckInResult\n    try {\n      result = await target.checkIn()\n    } catch {\n      // A transport-level throw (no credential at all, a rejection) is not a\n      // settled day: leave the record alone so a later sweep can retry.\n      return\n    }\n    try {\n      if (result.status !== 'error') {\n        this.store.write(target.variantId, {\n          lastDate: result.date,\n          lastAt: result.timestamp,\n          status: result.status,\n          amount: result.amount,\n          message: result.message,\n        })\n        if (result.status === 'claimed') {\n          target.onClaimed?.()\n        }\n      }\n      this.onResult?.(result)\n    } catch {\n      // Ignored to protect loop\n    }\n  }\n}\n"
